Lena (CS): Quick week0 check for VerdantPass private/VPC deploy. Open items: NAT egress CIDR, firewall SR to allow Redwood control plane, CMK policy to permit cross-account decrypt, and audit log export to customer's S3 with 365d retention. Renewal note: trial usage trending toward 20% of commit; watch for 40% threshold.

Kai (Customer): Egress CIDR will be 18.204.0.0/16 via our NAT. Bucket created verdantpass-redwood-logs. Monthly KMS rotation OK. I'll DM the bastion IPs and route tables.

Arun (Network): Need TGW attach ID and private endpoint subnet IDs. For firewall SR I'll open outbound 443 and 5263 to control plane ranges. Any objections to LB healthcheck hitting /health every 30s?

Sofia (Security): Current key policy is tight. Draft snippet posted in ticket VP-400 allowing role arn:aws:iam::111222333444:role/Redwood-Worker for kms:Decrypt and kms:GenerateDataKey. Also recommend enabling CloudTrail validation for 365d.

TicketBot: Created VP-400: "verdantpass - CMK policy + firewall SR + routes" assigned to Arun, Sofia.

Lena (CS): Actions: 1) Kai to share TGW attach and bastion IPs (Kai). 2) Arun to file firewall SR and confirm healthcheck path (Arun). 3) Sofia to post final CMK policy and request Redwood ARN if needed (Sofia). Target smoke test Friday 09:00 PST.

Kai (Customer): Will add TGW attach and route IDs today and attach S3 put policy. Thanks!
